_about: Hand-curated archive membership for Newsletter Archive v1 (Jul 21 - Oct 4, 2026; issues are the exact sent builds, keyed by send date). scripts/build_archive.js turns this into pages/archive/*. Item URLs are existing permanent pages (Handbook 8); they are never moved or renamed. 'hidden' pages stay live but are not listed.

numbering._about: Newspaper-style issue numbers: Vol. 1, No. 1 = the first resident issue, sent 2026-07-21. Each SENT issue (not corrections or notices) is the next No.; the volume goes up on every Jul 21 anniversary and No. restarts at 1. scripts/build_archive.js checks every issues[].volume/number against this rule.

community-stories.title: Community Stories
community-stories.lead: Stories about Palm Hill neighbors and park life. The current story comes first, then earlier stories, newest first. Each story has a read-aloud version.

items.title: 97½ and Still Chasing Birdies Instead of Birthdays
items.byline: Carolyn M. Story, as told by Mary Leslie
items.summary: Mary Leslie, 97½, on nearly four decades at Palm Hill, eleven holes-in-one here, and why she counts fairways, not years.

items.title: For the Love of the Game: Marge Taylor
